seriesTitle: Alexander: The Making of a God

episodes.title: The Boy King
episodes.summary: After a violent murder, a young Alexander ascends the throne of Macedonia and takes up arms against the mighty Persian Empire, ruled by Darius III.

episodes.title: Death or Victory
episodes.summary: The tyrant inside Alexander starts to emerge as he leads his army to victory in western Persia, forcing Darius III to reassess his opponent.

episodes.title: Face to Face
episodes.summary: Alexander defies the odds again and defeats Darius III at the Battle of Issus. He then falls back to set his sights on an unexpected target: Egypt.

episodes.title: The Golden Empire
episodes.summary: Alexander finds new purpose in Egypt and embarks on a perilous journey to find an ancient oracle and learn his true identity.

episodes.title: The Living God
episodes.summary: Alexander embraces his destiny as his army plunges into the heart of Persia. With peace off the table, a final showdown against Darius III is inevitable.

episodes.title: A World Still to Conquer
episodes.summary: With the Persian Empire in his hands and Darius III at his feet, Alexander burns with renewed ambition as he seeks to conquer the entire world.
